Struct SamplerDesc

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura

Describes the parameters used to control how textures are sampled in rendering operations, including filtering, addressing modes, level-of-detail bias, and comparison functions.

Remarks

Use this structure to configure how a texture sampler interprets texture coordinates, applies filtering, and handles out-of-bounds accesses. The settings in this structure affect the visual quality, performance, and behavior of texture lookups in graphics applications. Adjusting properties such as filter type, addressing modes, and anisotropy can help achieve the desired balance between image quality and rendering speed.

Remarks

The filter type determines how texture data is interpolated during sampling operations. Changing this value affects the visual quality and performance of texture lookups.
